import type { ComponentType, SVGProps } from 'react'
import {
  Activity,
  ArrowDown,
  ArrowLeft,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowUp,
  Bell,
  Calendar,
  Check,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronsUpDown,
  CircleHelp,
  Clipboard,
  Copy,
  ExternalLink,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  File,
  FileText,
  Filter,
  Hash,
  Home,
  Image,
  Info,
  LayoutDashboard,
  LoaderCircle,
  LogOut,
  Menu,
  MoreHorizontal,
  Pencil,
  Plus,
  Search,
  Settings,
  Trash2,
  Upload,
  User,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react'

const iconMap: Record<string, ComponentType<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>>> = {
  'activity': Activity,
  'arrow-down': ArrowDown,
  'arrow-left': ArrowLeft,
  'arrow-right': ArrowRight,
  'arrow-up': ArrowUp,
  'bell': Bell,
  'calendar': Calendar,
  'check': Check,
  'chevron-down': ChevronDown,
  'chevron-left': ChevronLeft,
  'chevron-right': ChevronRight,
  'chevrons-up-down': ChevronsUpDown,
  'circle-help': CircleHelp,
  'clipboard': Clipboard,
  'copy': Copy,
  'external-link': ExternalLink,
  'eye': Eye,
  'eye-off': EyeOff,
  'file': File,
  'file-text': FileText,
  'filter': Filter,
  'hash': Hash,
  'home': Home,
  'image': Image,
  'info': Info,
  'layout-dashboard': LayoutDashboard,
  'loader-circle': LoaderCircle,
  'log-out': LogOut,
  'menu': Menu,
  'more-horizontal': MoreHorizontal,
  'pencil': Pencil,
  'plus': Plus,
  'search': Search,
  'settings': Settings,
  'trash-2': Trash2,
  'upload': Upload,
  'user': User,
  'x': X,
}

export function Icon({ name, ...props }: SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> & { name?: string }) {
  const IconComponent = name ? iconMap[name] : undefined
  if (!IconComponent) return null
  return <IconComponent aria-hidden="true" {...props} />
}
